_privacy.title: Privacy Policy
_privacy.noTrackingDescription: Fithacker does not use cookies or tracking technology.
_privacy.emailOptionalDescription: Email registration is optional. If provided, your email is only used for login and never shared with third parties or used for marketing.
_privacy.dataStorageDescription: Your exercise logs are stored locally on your device. If you log in, your data will be backed up to our GDPR-compliant cloud provider: Supabase. You can delete your cloud backup anytime while keeping your local data.
_privacy.dataControlDescription: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Manage your account and delete your cloud backup directly in the app anytime.
_privacy.thirdPartyDescription: Optional cloud backup via Supabase with authentication emails via Resend. Both are GDPR-compliant and only used for core app functionality.
